kicker: e-means, k-means with a moving average

scenes.headline: How e-means clusters in a tenth of the epochs
scenes.sub: Mini-batches, a moving average, and two fitted laws.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Wrenly! Here is how e-means matches k-means in a fraction of the passes.

scenes.text: Update centroids from mini-batches with a moving average of counts and sums, and let fitted laws pick the batch and step.
scenes.mark: moving average of counts and sums
scenes.say: The idea: update centroids from small batches, with a moving average, and let fitted laws pick the batch and step.

scenes.title: One exact move, or many small ones

left.title: Lloyd
items: Loss only goes down, so it can get stuck
left.say: Lloyd makes one exact update per full pass, and can never climb out of a bad start.

right.title: e-means
right.say: e-means makes many noisy updates per pass, and the noise shakes stranded centroids loose.

steps.say: Take a mini-batch and assign each point to its nearest centroid.
Sum and count each cluster's points, and blend them into a moving average.
The centroid is sum over count. It lands between the old centroid and the batch mean, so it never overshoots.
The step follows a cosine down to a tenth of itself.
A starving cluster is rebuilt by splitting a busy donor.

scenes.title: Lloyd is a corner of this family
scenes.text: N = (1 - a) N + a n,  S = (1 - a) S + a s

parts.note: old count, faded by the step

parts.say: The batch adds its own count.

parts.note: batch = all data, step = 1 gives Lloyd
parts.say: Use the whole dataset and a step of one, and this is exactly Lloyd.

scenes.title: The recipe from n, k and T
scenes.say: Two power laws, fitted on about seventy-five thousand runs, choose the batch and step.

items.text: Batch grows almost linearly with n
items.say: The batch grows almost linearly with the data.
The step grows with the batch.
A million points, three epochs: forty-eight updates against Lloyd's three.

steps.say: On DINO vectors, e-means passes Lloyd's twenty-five epoch loss in about two epochs.
The paper reports about ten times less GPU time at every size.

scenes.title: Epochs to reach Lloyd at 25
scenes.say: It needs one point four to two point six epochs. The final loss is only slightly lower; the win is compute.

scenes.text: Lloyd was the most expensive point in a bigger family. Smaller, noisier, well-scheduled steps get there sooner.
scenes.mark: most expensive point in a bigger family
scenes.say: Lloyd was the most expensive point in this family. Smaller, scheduled steps get there sooner.

recap: Moving average of counts and sums
scenes.say: Moving averages, a cosine step, splitting, and fitted laws. Thanks for watching!
